value.rationale: Exact identification of pair-orbit equivalence despite a strictly larger full automorphism group has direct meaning in permutation-group symmetry of nonconnected quandles; index 2^{d(2^d-d-1)} grows rapidly and explains why binary orbit invariants cannot detect many nonlinear quandle symmetries.
